question: the destination axis is 27,259 pages across six families and the cap is the 13-entry DESTINATION scope list in build-1m-candidate-manifest.py, not the data. Which of the families that reach a destination country and produce nothing can be opened, and on what evidence?

the_four_families_that_generate_rows_and.destinations.city-hub: 26,179 rows, all rejected REJECTED_QUALITY no defensible uniqueness basis

what_was_found_first.the_cause_of_the_three_quality_rejection: their required_data cell in FAMILY-MASTER.csv is EMPTY, and uniqueness_reason() returns an empty string when a family declares fewer than two source fields. weather.city-month declares "geonames-cities; nasa-power-daily" and produces 22,927 pages from the same store.
what_was_found_first.the_cause_of_the_serp_rejection: the serp_class for weather.city-best-time came from two rows in 08-SERP-EVIDENCE.csv whose keywords are "wetter konstanz" and "spokane weather". Those are current weather queries, their SERP is a knowledge card, and both rows are DUPLICATES of rows 8, 9 and 25 which carry the same two keywords correctly filed under weather.city. Their own reason column reads "sampled no". serp_by_fam takes the first row it sees for a family, so two mislabelled duplicates rejected 29,210 rows.

the_serp_was_then_sampled_on_the_right_i.method: serp-overview, top ten, three markets, 2026-10-06, 918 units

the_serp_was_then_sampled_on_the_right_i.and_across_the_92_english_rows_measured_: knowledge_card appears in ZERO of them. ai_overview appears in 71. So the correct class is OPEN with an AI overview recorded, and the AI overview is the honest caveat on click through rate, not a reason to refuse.

then_the_obvious_gate_was_tested_and_ref.the_hypothesis: admit a best-time page wherever the (market, city) pair already has an activities.city-things-to-do page, since that family proved destination demand
then_the_obvious_gate_was_tested_and_ref.the_test: the twenty city tail probe against the things-to-do set, 2026-10-06
then_the_obvious_gate_was_tested_and_ref.cities_with_a_things_to_do_page_that_rea: Akron 0, Tulsa 0, Konstanz 0, Leipzig 0, Rostock 0, Lille 0, Marseille 0, Strasbourg 0
then_the_obvious_gate_was_tested_and_ref.conclusion: the sibling family predicts this one in neither direction. The intent follows whether a place has a season that decides the trip, which neither population nor POI count nor a sibling family predicts. So every city in this family is measured one keyword at a time. This is the brief rule applied to itself: demand is measured, not inferred.

what_this_family_is_actually_worth.what_the_measurement_supports_so_far: 160 (language, city) pairs cleared the floor in the first wave across en, de, fr and it, out of 615 measured. Extrapolating the measured hit rates across the full queue of 13,547 cities in those four languages gives roughly 3,100 to 3,500 pairs, and each pair becomes one page per market sharing that language. So this family is worth thousands, not 29,210, and the difference is the point: 26,000 of those rows are cities with no measurable best-time demand.
what_this_family_is_actually_worth.and_this_is_the_right_outcome: the brief says a million URLs just to reach the number is not wanted. A family that generates a row for every city in the gazetteer and keeps only the ones a person actually searches is the gate working.

climate.city-annual.evidence: X climate reads 150 to 2,000 but the parent_topic points elsewhere in eleven of fifteen English readings and in almost every German, French and Italian one: amsterdam climate to "amsterdam", tokyo climate to "tokyo", clima roma to "meteo", rom klima to "klimatabelle rom", clima barcellona to "meteo barcellona", climat lisbonne to "quand partir a lisbonne". The query is absorbed either by the city itself or by the weather-by-month family that already holds 22,927 pages, or by the best-time family. Admitting it would cannibalise a live family, which is the thing this project guards against.
climate.city-annual.what_to_do_instead: carry the annual shape as a section of the month pages parent, not as its own URL

climate.city-day.evidence: the entity is city-date and the only source is NASA POWER MONTHLY normals. A daily figure derived from a monthly mean is a precision the source does not carry. No keyword was measured for it because the page could not be honest whatever the volume.

destinations.city-hub.evidence: X travel guide reads 250 to 2,400 in en-US at CPC 20 to 120 cents, which is the best commercial signal of the three, but the parent topics are "things to do in bangkok", "visiting paris", "what to see in rome", "barcelona travel" and "amsterdam travel": the same topic activities.city-things-to-do already holds with 30,040 pairs. And outside English it is dead: X reisefuehrer reads 10 in German for every city tested and guida di viaggio X reads 0 to 30 in Italian.
destinations.city-hub.what_to_do_instead: the commercial signal is real and belongs on the things-to-do page, as a title and copy question, not as a second URL competing with it
